summary: Preflight confirmed the target worktree and interpreter. OpenCode 1.18.30 omits --yolo from help but accepted a harmless --dangerously-skip-permissions probe, which returned FLAG_PROBE with exit code 0. This user-authorized alternative is used for the read-only C0 gate. The v4 CONUS instance, geo cache, and TD_ZCTA_SHP are absent or unset, so a later real CONUS benchmark will need data setup.

tests.command: opencode run --dangerously-skip-permissions --pure --model opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro --format json --title agy-permission-flag-probe -- "Reply exactly FLAG_PROBE and do not call tools."

followups: Run C0 with the accepted user-authorized alternative flag. Provide the confidential v4 instance, geo cache, and shapefile before any CONUS benchmark.
learned: LEARNED: OpenCode 1.18.30 accepts --dangerously-skip-permissions in headless run mode even though its help advertises only --auto.
